entities.name: Rossana de los Ríos
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Rossana Neffa de los Rios is a former tennis player from Paraguay. She was born in the Paraguayan capital, Asunción, and now resides in Miami, Florida, with her daughter Ana Paula Neffa de los Ríos, who is also a professional tennis player, and her husband Gustavo Neffa, a retired Paraguayan Association football player who played for Boca Juniors.

De los Ríos achieved career-high WTA rankings of No. 51 in singles and 52 in doubles. She played doubles with Grand Slam champions such as Maria Sharapova, Svetlana Kuznetsova, Arantxa Sánchez Vicario, as well as Jelena Janković and Dinara Safina. Rossana de los Ríos was a athletes & competitors from Asunción (b. 1975-09-16, Asunción). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
